independent_verification.findings: All nopriv AJAX handlers are session-scoped, nonce-gated, or operate within intended guest-checkout semantics (covered by NEG-001 through NEG-006). All REST routes carry explicit permission_callback implementations — none use __return_true or omit the callback. WP_Async_Request::maybe_handle() uses check_ajax_referer() without the false flag, enforcing strict nonce termination. NPS survey REST endpoints require manage_options. No new signals identified.
